instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE through the graphical user interface to perform a modal analysis of a cantilever beam (Variant B). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Model Definition:
Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a 14 mm x 8 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane and extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 360 mm.

Material and Section:
Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa, Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3, and density = 7.95e-9 tonne/mm^3. Create a Solid Homogeneous section using Steel and assign it to the entire beam.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the beam.

Analysis Step:
Create a Linear Perturbation Frequency step named Step-Modal-B. Request 5 eigenvalues.

Loads and Boundary Conditions:
Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the fixed end face at X = 0.

Discretization:
Mesh the beam with a global seed size of 10 mm. Assign the element type C3D8R and generate the mesh.

Job Execution:
Create a job named Job-Modal-B, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully.

Deliverables:
Save the model database as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Modal-B.cae and ensure the output database is written to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Modal-B.odb.
